updates.sentence: The federal court records two consecutive five-years-to-life terms beginning in 1965. Subsequently detained in the San Quentin Adjustment Center and prosecuted in the San Quentin Six case; acquitted August 12, 1976. Contemporary Associated Press reporting confirms physical release Friday, August 20, 1976. The original arrest day and admission month remain unresolved.

entries.rationale: Court p540 places original sentence service in1965; some later summaries say1966, so retain court-supported year with no invented month/day. AP August22 says he leftFriday. updates.charges: 1965 assault-with-a-deadly-weapon conviction while already in custody; later San Quentin Six prosecution, acquitted in August 1976.
updates.sentence: The federal court records a 1965 sentence of six months to ten years, imposed while Tate was already in custody. This entry dates that documented prison term at year precision; his earlier juvenile custody began before it. After the prison term ended, he remained in Marin County jail until his release on $100,000 bail on January 14, 1975. The August 1976 acquittal was not his release from custody.

entries.rationale: Court p540 and contemporary Panther January25 p5 corroborate January14,1975 bail release. Court p541 contains an apparent1974 typo; preceding page and contemporary report resolve it.1965 marks documented adult term, not claimed beginning of all custody. Remove unsupported1971arrest and1976release.
